chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās narrated from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, that he said:
The nobles of my Ummah are the bearers of the Qur'an and the people of the night.

key_terms.أَشْرَافُ أُمَّتِي: the most noble and honored members of my community
key_terms.أَصْحَابُ اللَّيْلِ: those devoted to worship and vigil during the night
key_terms.حَمَلَةُ الْقُرْآنِ: those who bear, preserve, recite, and live by the Qur'an

ai.seo_question: Who are considered the noble ones of the Ummah in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith honors two elevated groups in the Ummah: those who carry the Qur'an through learning, recitation, and preservation, and those devoted to worship in the night. It emphasizes that true nobility is rooted in closeness to divine revelation and sincere nightly devotion.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5855 - Abdullah ibn Abbas narrated from the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, that the Prophet (sw) said:
"The nobles of my nation are the bearers of the Qur'an and those who engage in prayer during the night."
